nom: The Crème Shop Cotton Candy Skin Hydrocolloid Acne Patches

segments.normal: A reviewer who describes her skin as normal and rarely prone to breakouts, and another reviewer's sister with dry/normal skin, both reported no effect from the patches on their pimples.
segments.dry: One reviewer's dry/normal-skinned sister saw no effect on her pimples, while a separate reviewer whose skin turns dry in winter found the tea-tree patches helped shrink and extract stubborn zits.
segments.combination: Combination-skinned reviewers differ: one said the patches adhered well but only helped pimples that were already close to a head, while another with combination/oily skin found they did not help at all.
segments.oily: One reviewer with combination/oily skin reported no effect on her pimples, while another whose skin runs oily in summer found the tea-tree formula helped reduce and extract stubborn zits.
segments.sensitive: One reviewer with sensitive skin (oily in summer, dry in winter) found the tea-tree patches were not an instant fix but did help reduce the size of blemishes and bring deep ones to a head over about 24 hours.

concerns.blemishes: Opinions split sharply on core efficacy: many reviewers, including some who wore the patches multiple nights in a row, report no visible change to their pimples at all, while a similar number describe them flattening or shrinking blemishes and drawing out pus or gunk overnight, especially on whiteheads and pimples already close to a head; several note they work better on smaller, more 'poppable' pimples than on large cystic acne.
concerns.spots: A few reviewers connect the patches to dark spots and scarring: some say the patches sped up fading of post-pimple dark marks or helped avoid a dark mark by bringing stubborn acne to a head before it could scar, while another says the patches themselves left some scarring that needed a separate product to address.
concerns.redness: Two reviewers specifically noted the patches reduced redness around blemishes overnight, leaving them looking calmer and flatter by morning.

aspects.libelle: Largest size still small for big cysts
Contains tea tree oil, not just hydrocolloid

extraits.texte: I have pretty normal skin and rarely get breakouts. Once in a while though I will get small pimples. I used the entire package and followed all the instructions but there wasnt a single time where I experienced these working. They are cute, but they serve no purpose beyond that.
one star for cuteness but dont work at all. even though they are cheap not worth even keeping. my sister and i both tried she is dry/normal skin & im combo/oily & didnt do anything to our pimples.

I purchased these because a friend of mine reccomended them to me. I found that they were really cute and they stuck well to my skin despite my combination skin, however they don't really do much for pimples that aren't incredibly "poppable".

I use these religiously. I don't ususlly buy cutesy stuff like this but its effective!! Regardless of the stage of your pimple's growth - it helps with inflammation. For me, these usually suck out all the guck overnight. I even take a pack or two with me when I go on trips. Only thing is that these patches leave some scarring, which you'll need a seperate product for.

I have hormonal acne that is so stubborn, it will cause bumps on my skin but doesn't rise up and eventually flattens out but leaves dark spots. These stickers have been wonderful to bring the acne to the top surface of my skin and easily pops out. The infection is gone entirely and no scars are left behind. Not to mention they are super cute when you have them on. Definitely a must-have!

extraits.titre: Does What It Says (But It's Not Magic)
extraits.texte: I'm in my late 30s with sensitive skin that's oily in summer, dry in winter and just an overall mess most of the time. I got some plain, non-medicated zit stickers elsewhere and they helped a lot just by covering the zit so it didn't accumulate more oil through the day. These ones work the same way but the tea tree seems to reduce the size of the zit and/or get the deep ones to develop a head so they can be extracted. These are also cuter than the plain version (a little bit quirky on an adult but whatever) and I've worn them during the day under the bridge of my glasses on one side to keep the zit that I keep getting there to stop it from getting worse. Like the other reviews say, they aren't magic and they won't make your zits magically disappear in a couple hours and they're too small to cover the really big cystic acne---but if you use them for like 24 hours they will do some serious work.

extraits.titre: Skeptical due to cystic acne... sold after the first use!
extraits.texte: I always hated having acne... but with these stickers, they're not only cute but they also serve their purpose! They truly do help with the redness and my stubborn whiteheads. It brings them to the surface, and sometimes they pop on their own and these patches will hold all the gunk in there while extracting more! Love these!!!
